system.description:
You inscribe a Chakra seal onto the palm of your hand and create a three-point seal.

Make a melee Ninjutsu attack, dealing 4d6 chakra damage and forcing the affected creature make a Charisma saving throw, gaining a rank of Sealed on a failed save.

Seal Break. If a creature within 30 feet of you have ranks of Sealed, you can dispel one rank of that creatures Sealed condition to change this jutsu’s range to Self (15-Cube) originating from you, comparing your attack result to all creatures in the affected area.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the number of ranks of Sealed by +1. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank increase the number of ranks of Sealed by +2.
